svg.text: The VCV Library page: today vs proposed
Rack makes Library images with Window::screenshotModules: no module instance (createModuleWidget(NULL)) and preferDarkPanels forced off. So the light panel, in its default width, is the product shot.
Dark panels (no light variant), a transport display with four grey squares. Nothing says piano roll, clips or arranger.
Proposed (light panels, as the Library renders them)
The screen draws the demo song (previewSong) as the mosaic: coloured clips, one playing, one queued.
The accent tab on the right edge says the panel opens into an editor.
Why it reads at a glance:
• a dark screen full of coloured tiles = clips, the first thing the eye finds
• the four-tile mark repeats the idea in the title
• PLAY / REC / LOOP are larger and lit; the rest are grouped and quieter
• outputs on the inverted plate, inputs on the face: Rack convention
• one accent (lapis) for Open editor and the edge tab
